# Provenance {#sec-provenance}

```{r}
#| include: false
source("../_setup.R")
# The synthetic example writes its own input, so the table has a real file to hash.
example_input <- file.path(tempdir(), "counts.tsv")
sc <- synth_counts(n_per_group = 4)
write.table(sc$counts, example_input, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)
inputs <- data.frame(
  input = c("counts.tsv", "annotation.tsv"),
  path = c(example_input, file.path(tempdir(), "annotation.tsv")),
  required = c(TRUE, FALSE)
)
inputs$present <- file.exists(inputs$path)
inputs$sha256 <- NA_character_
inputs$sha256[inputs$present] <- vapply(inputs$path[inputs$present], sha256_file, character(1))
manifest_path <- file.path(report_root(), "run-manifest.json")
```

This page records what the book was built from: the inputs, the run that produced them, and the software that loaded.

## Inputs {#sec-provenance-inputs}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-provenance-inputs
#| tbl-cap: "Inputs, whether each is required and present, and the first 16 hex characters of its SHA-256."
shown <- inputs[, c("input", "required", "present", "sha256")]
shown$sha256[is.na(shown$sha256) & shown$present] <- "checksum tool unavailable"
shown$sha256[!shown$present] <- "not applicable"
knitr::kable(shown, col.names = c("Input", "Required", "Present", "SHA-256 (first 16)"))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
for (i in which(!inputs$required & !inputs$present)) {
  cat("Optional input `", inputs$input[i], "` is absent. Sections that use it render a ",
      "not-applicable note. This run is degraded, not complete.\n\n", sep = "")
}
if (any(inputs$present & is.na(inputs$sha256))) {
  cat("A checksum could not be computed. A check that could not run counts as a failure, not a pass.\n\n")
}
```

- Are the checksums those of the files the analysis actually read?

## Run manifest {#sec-provenance-manifest}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
if (!file.exists(manifest_path)) {
  cat(
    "::: {.callout-caution}\n## No run manifest\n",
    "No run manifest was found next to the book. When the analysis ran, whether it ran ",
    "cleanly, and which steps failed are all unknown. Treat every result as unchecked.\n:::\n"
  )
} else {
  m <- jsonlite::fromJSON(manifest_path)
  failed <- if (length(m$failed_steps)) paste(m$failed_steps, collapse = ", ") else "none"
  cat("The run manifest was written ", m$written, ". Clean run: ", m$clean,
      ". Failed steps: ", failed, ".\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Environment {#sec-provenance-environment}

::: {.callout-note}
## Why the resolved environment
This table lists what loaded when the book rendered. A lockfile says what should load. When the two disagree, the loaded versions are the ones that produced these numbers.
:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-provenance-environment
#| tbl-cap: "Attached packages and their loaded versions, from the session that rendered this page."
si <- sessionInfo()
pk <- si$otherPkgs
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Package = c("R", names(pk)),
  Version = c(paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = "."),
              vapply(pk, function(p) p$Version, character(1))),
  row.names = NULL
))
```

The platform was `r si$platform`.
